run_f_gold: run Horner's method to evaluate a polynomial at a given x value
test_f_gold: test the f_gold function against multiple polynomial coefficient sets and x values
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to support negative indices or sparse polynomial representations
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold Horner's method polynomial evaluation algorithm and its O(n) complexity
review_f_gold: review the f_gold function for edge cases like empty polynomials or n larger than poly length
